description: This file provides API functions for interacting with a notes backend, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes, with support for multiple backend response formats and environment-based configuration.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the backend base URL from environment variables, defaulting to relative URL.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with timeout and error handling, returning JSON or text payload.

methods.name: normalizeListResponse
methods.description: Normalizes various backend response shapes into an array of notes.

methods.name: tryGetNotes
methods.description: Attempts to fetch notes from multiple endpoint variants for compatibility.

methods.name: tryCreateNote
methods.description: Attempts to create a note via multiple endpoint variants.

methods.name: tryUpdateNote
methods.description: Attempts to update a note via multiple endpoint variants.

methods.name: tryDeleteNote
methods.description: Attempts to delete a note via multiple endpoint variants.
